title: (2nd LD) Seoul shares dip over 3 pct amid escalating AI woes
caption:
South Korea's benchmark KOSPI index saw a massive sell-off as concerns grow over the profitability of AI. Major chipmakers like Samsung and SK hynix took the biggest hits following similar skepticism on Wall Street.
